nodes.label: Quality-Aware Scaling Laws for LLMs
nodes.rationale: Extends Chinchilla scaling law with dimensionless quality parameter Q, predicting loss as L(N,D,Q) = A/N^α + B/(D^β Q^γ) + E to model data quality impact.

nodes.label: Data Quality Parameter Q
nodes.rationale: Dimensionless parameter Q ∈ (0,1] quantifying usable information in corpus. Estimated via corruption rate (Q=1-CR) or data deficiency measure. Q=1 represents clean data.

nodes.label: Effective Sample Size Framework
nodes.rationale: Formalizes D_eff = D·g(Q) where g(Q)≈Q^γ. Lemma 1 shows γ≈1 for Gaussian noise (SNR scaling); Lemma 2 shows γ≈2 for random classification noise.

nodes.label: NMT and CLM Experiments
nodes.rationale: Controlled experiments on English-German translation (Paracrawl) and causal language modeling (C4) with synthetic noise injection at 7 quality levels and 3 dataset sizes.

nodes.label: Data Quality in LLM Pretraining
nodes.rationale: Data quality dimensions: accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness, validity. In LLM pretraining, quality varies across web sources; filtering and deduplication improve performance.

nodes.label: Information-Theoretic Perspective on Scaling Laws
nodes.rationale: Corruption reduces mutual information multiplicatively: I(X̃;Z) ≈ ρ(Q)·I(X;Z). Loss scales with mutual information; quality-aware law emerges from information-theoretic generalization bounds.

nodes.label: Quality-Aware Scaling Laws for LLM Pretraining
nodes.rationale: Introduces explicit dimensionless measure of data quality Q alongside model size N and dataset volume D, extending Chinchilla framework to predict pretraining loss as joint function of all three factors.

nodes.label: Data Quality Measure (Q)
nodes.rationale: Dimensionless measure of data quality that captures noise, corruption, and information loss; defined as Q = e^(-Δ) where Δ is data deficiency.

nodes.label: Chinchilla Scaling Framework
nodes.rationale: Widely-used framework for predicting pretraining loss as function of model size N and dataset volume D; extended by quality-aware scaling law to include data quality Q.

nodes.label: ParaCrawl Dataset
nodes.rationale: Web-scale parallel corpus for English-German machine translation; used in quality-aware scaling law experiments with systematic noise injection.

nodes.label: C4 Dataset
nodes.rationale: Large-scale cleaned web corpus used for causal language modeling experiments in quality-aware scaling law study.

hyperedges.label: Data Quality Impact on Scaling Laws
hyperedges.rationale: Unified framework: quality parameter Q quantifies data usability, effective sample size formalizes how quality reduces usable information, information theory justifies the multiplicative Q^γ term in scaling law.
